title: The Urgent Race to Control 'Killer Robots'
subtitle: As technology advances, the Red Cross warns that the window to set global rules for autonomous weapons is closing fast.

summary.en: International talks at the United Nations in Geneva have concluded without a plan for a legally binding treaty on autonomous weapons. The International Committee of the Red Cross is now warning that these systems are developing faster than global regulations. Autonomous weapons use artificial intelligence to operate without direct human supervision. Experts fear that without clear international limits, these weapons could cause even more civilian harm. The debate highlights a growing tension between rapid military innovation and the need for ethical boundaries.
summary.zh: 在日內瓦舉行的聯合國國際會談結束，未能就自主武器的法律約束條約達成計畫。紅十字國際委員會警告，這些系統的發展速度已超越全球監管能力。自主武器利用人工智慧在無人類直接監督下運作。專家擔憂，若缺乏明確的國際限制，這些武器可能造成更多平民傷亡。這場辯論凸顯了軍事創新快速發展與建立道德界線需求之間日益加劇的緊張關係。

paragraphs.en: Following the recent conclusion of United Nations talks in Geneva, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has issued a serious warning about the future of warfare. Despite a week of discussions involving more than 120 member states, the international community has failed to reach an agreement on a legally binding treaty—a formal, written contract between countries—to regulate autonomous weapons. These are military systems that use artificial intelligence (AI) or robotics to act without direct human supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 在日內瓦舉行的聯合國會談近期結束後，紅十字國際委員會（ICRC）針對未來戰爭型態發出了嚴正警告。儘管超過一百二十個成員國進行了為期一週的討論，國際社會仍未能就一項具有法律約束力的條約達成共識，即一份國家間正式的書面契約，以規範自主武器。這些武器是指利用人工智慧或機器人技術，在沒有人類直接監督下運作的軍事系統。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the ICRC believes that the world is running out of time to control this technology. Dr. Cordula Droege, the director of international law at the ICRC, stated that if these systems remain unregulated, it will soon be impossible to manage their use. She compared the situation to trying to put a “genie back in the bottle,” suggesting that once these weapons are fully integrated into global militaries, they will be very difficult to stop or control.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》報導，紅十字國際委員會認為，全球控制這項技術的時間已所剩無幾。該委員會的國際法主任柯杜拉·德羅格博士（Dr. Cordula Droege）指出，若這些系統持續處於無監管狀態，很快將無法掌控其使用。她將此情況比喻為試圖將「精靈放回瓶中」，意指一旦這些武器完全整合進全球軍隊，將極難停止或控制。

paragraphs.en: The recent UN conference, which followed earlier meetings that also failed to produce strong rules, highlighted a deep divide. While many countries support strict regulations, the UN requires total agreement from all members to move forward. This rule allowed major powers to block the creation of a new, binding treaty. As a result, the conference ended without the urgent action that many rights groups believe is necessary to address the growing threat.
paragraphs.zh: 近期這場聯合國會議延續了先前未能制定強力規範的幾次會議，凸顯了嚴重的分歧。雖然許多國家支持嚴格監管，但聯合國規定必須全體成員達成共識才能推動進程。這項規則讓大國得以阻撓新條約的制定。結果，會議在未能採取許多人權團體認為應對日益增長的威脅所必需的緊急行動下結束。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous weapons are already being used in conflicts around the world. In the Ukraine-Russia war, for example, semi-autonomous drones have been deployed with “last-mile capability.” This means that while a human might start the mission, the AI takes control during the final moments to hit a target. Tragically, in July, a Russian drone guided by an AI system crashed into a wall in Zaporizhzhia instead of its intended target, killing three civilians. In Gaza, the Israeli military has used AI-assisted methods to create lists of targets much faster than humans could, which rights groups argue has led to the accidental killing of civilians and people with only weak connections to militant groups.
paragraphs.zh: 自主武器已在世界各地的衝突中使用。例如在烏俄戰爭中，具備「最後一哩路能力」的半自主無人機已被部署。這意味著雖然任務由人類啟動，但人工智慧會在最後時刻接管以擊中目標。悲劇的是，七月時，一架由人工智慧系統導引的俄羅斯無人機在札波羅熱撞上一面牆，而非原定目標，導致三名平民喪生。在加薩，以色列軍方利用人工智慧輔助方法建立目標清單，其速度遠超人類，人權團體認為這導致了平民及與武裝團體關聯薄弱者遭到誤殺。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the dangers of relying on AI for military decisions are not limited to the battlefield. Reports indicate that a US strike in Iran, which killed 156 people including 120 schoolchildren at an elementary school, was the result of faulty intelligence gathered by AI systems. These examples show that when machines make life-or-death decisions, the risk of error is high and the results are often devastating for innocent people.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，依賴人工智慧進行軍事決策的危險不僅限於戰場。有報導指出，美國在伊朗發動的一場空襲造成一百五十六人死亡，其中包括一所小學的一百二十名學童，這起事件是人工智慧系統蒐集錯誤情報所導致。這些案例顯示，當機器做出攸關生死的決策時，出錯風險極高，且對無辜民眾造成的後果往往是毀滅性的。

paragraphs.en: The ICRC, along with UN Secretary General António Guterres, is calling for clear rules. They want a ban on using autonomous weapons to target human beings directly. They also want to ensure that all weapon systems behave in a predictable way and that their use is limited to specific military objectives. Dr. Droege emphasized that the goal is not to ban all technology, but to set “red lines” that should never be crossed. She argued that targeting human beings through machines is a moral line that the world must protect.
paragraphs.zh: 紅十字國際委員會與聯合國秘書長古特瑞斯（António Guterres）正呼籲制定明確規則。他們要求禁止使用自主武器直接鎖定人類。他們也希望確保所有武器系統的行為具備可預測性，並將其使用限制在特定的軍事目標內。德羅格博士強調，目標並非禁止所有技術，而是設立絕不能跨越的「紅線」。她主張，透過機器鎖定人類是一條全球必須守護的道德底線。

paragraphs.en: Experts from organizations like the Future of Life Institute warn that any further delay in creating a strong treaty could have dangerous consequences. If governments do not act, private companies and military leaders may set their own rules, which might prioritize speed and efficiency over human rights and safety. Anna Hehir, the head of military AI governance at the institute, noted that the current pace of development is outstripping the pace of diplomacy.
paragraphs.zh: 來自「未來生命研究所」（Future of Life Institute）等組織的專家警告，任何在制定強力條約上的拖延都可能帶來危險後果。若各國政府不採取行動，私人企業與軍事領袖可能會自行制定規則，這可能導致速度與效率被置於人權與安全之上。該研究所的軍事人工智慧治理負責人安娜·赫希爾（Anna Hehir）指出，目前的發展速度已超越了外交進程。

paragraphs.en: As the world looks toward the future, the question remains whether international leaders can find common ground before the technology becomes too advanced to manage. The failure to reach an agreement in Geneva is a setback for those who believe that machines should never be allowed to make the decision to kill. For now, the debate continues, but the window for effective regulation is closing. Without a clear international framework, the world faces a future where the risks of AI in warfare may become a permanent and uncontrollable part of global conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 當世界展望未來，問題在於國際領袖是否能在技術變得過於先進而難以管理前找到共識。在日內瓦未能達成協議，對那些認為絕不應允許機器做出殺人決策的人士而言是一次挫敗。目前辯論仍在持續，但有效監管的窗口正逐漸關閉。若缺乏明確的國際架構，世界將面臨一個人工智慧在戰爭中的風險可能成為全球衝突中永久且不可控部分的未來。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop something from happening or moving forward.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（街區、積木），這裡作動詞用。文中：This rule allowed major powers to block the creation of a new, binding treaty.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Growing or developing faster than something else.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此字較正式，指科技發展的速度快過外交協商的速度。文中：Anna Hehir, the head of military AI governance at the institute, noted that the current pace of development is outstripping the pace of diplomacy.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To have very little or none of something left.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常用於時間或資源，這裡指時間緊迫。文中：According to The Guardian, the ICRC believes that the world is running out of time to control this technology.

previousArticles.summaryEn: International discussions at the United Nations regarding autonomous weapons have failed to produce a legally binding treaty. Despite support from over 100 countries, the need for total agreement allowed major powers to block stricter rules. These weapons, which use artificial intelligence to choose targets, are already being used in conflicts worldwide. Humanitarian groups warn that allowing machines to make life-or-death decisions is a dangerous moral line. The new agreement only provides a two-year window for further, potentially optional, discussions.

previousArticles.title: UN Talks on 'Killer Robots' End Without Strong Rules
previousArticles.summaryEn: International discussions at the United Nations in Geneva have ended without a plan for a legally binding treaty on autonomous weapons. Although over 100 countries wanted strict rules to control these 'killer robots,' the UN requires total agreement from all 128 member states to pass new laws. Major military powers, including the United States, Russia, and Israel, opposed the stricter mandate. Instead, the group agreed to spend the next two years discussing options for future regulations. Critics argue that this delay is dangerous because these weapons are already being used in conflicts around the world.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the primary reason the UN conference failed to establish a binding treaty on autonomous weapons?

options.A: Most member states were against the idea of regulating military technology.
options.B: The requirement for total consensus allowed a minority of countries to block progress.
options.C: The conference ran out of time before they could finalize the written contract.
options.D: Rights groups and the ICRC could not agree on what the 'red lines' should be.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，聯合國的規定要求所有成員國達成共識才能推動協議，這使得大國得以阻擋新條約的制定。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到許多國家支持嚴格監管；選項 C 錯誤，因為失敗原因是規則限制而非時間不足；選項 D 錯誤，因為文中並未提到權利組織與 ICRC 在紅線定義上有衝突。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the future of autonomous weapons if no international agreement is reached?

options.A: Military leaders will likely abandon AI technology due to high error rates.
options.B: Private companies will be forced to shut down their AI military research projects.
options.C: The development of AI technology will likely be dictated by military efficiency rather than safety.
options.D: The UN will automatically ban all autonomous weapons once they become too advanced.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第七段，專家警告若政府不採取行動，私人企業與軍事領袖可能會自行制定規則，優先考量速度與效率而非人權與安全。選項 A 與文章提到的「軍事競賽」概念矛盾；選項 B 與文中提到的「私人企業可能自行設定規則」衝突；選項 D 錯誤，因為文中明確指出聯合國目前無法達成協議，且沒有自動禁令的機制。

quiz.question: In the seventh paragraph, what does the phrase 'outstripping the pace of diplomacy' mean?

options.A: Technological development is happening faster than international negotiations.
options.B: Diplomatic efforts are successfully slowing down the development of AI.
options.C: AI technology is becoming more expensive than the cost of international peace talks.
options.D: Military leaders are intentionally ignoring diplomatic requests to stop production.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，outstripping 意指「超過」或「領先」。文章提到科技發展速度過快，導致外交談判跟不上進度。選項 B 與文意相反；選項 C 提到的成本問題在文中並未討論；選項 D 雖然提到軍事領導人可能自行其是，但這句話主要是在強調科技發展的速度與外交進程之間的差距。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding autonomous weapons?

options.A: Autonomous weapons are necessary to ensure victory in modern wars like the one in Ukraine.
options.B: The ICRC and UN are working together to completely eliminate all AI technology from militaries.
options.C: AI-assisted targeting is highly accurate and has significantly reduced civilian casualties.
options.D: There is an urgent need for international regulation to prevent the uncontrollable and dangerous use of AI in warfare.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於強調國際社會未能達成共識，導致 AI 武器在缺乏監管的情況下持續擴散，造成平民傷亡與倫理危機，因此急需制定國際框架。選項 A 與文章立場相左；選項 B 錯誤，因為 ICRC 強調目標是設定紅線而非全面禁止科技；選項 C 完全違背文章中提到的多次誤殺平民的案例。
